name: week
title: This week across the network
subtitle: Franchise for Claude Code: what needs a decision, every site on one line, and the visits due, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Needs a decision
sections.note: Worst first. A signing inside the disclosure window or a late end of term notice outranks everything.
sections.sql: select reason as why, label as record, site, who, days, detail from v_attention order by rank, days desc nulls last

sections.title: The network
sections.note: Sales for the last three full months against the three before. Arrears are royalties and levy past their due date.
sections.sql: select ref, name as site, franchisee, state, currency, to_char(sales_3m_cents / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990') as sales_3m, coalesce(sales_trend_pct || '%', '') as trend, case when arrears_cents > 0 then to_char(arrears_cents / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990') else '' end as arrears, last_score as last_visit, open_findings as findings, open_tickets as tickets, agreement_state as agreement from v_sites where status <> 'closed' order by ref

sections.title: Field visits due in 30 days
sections.sql: select ref, name as site, field_manager, to_char(last_visit_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as last_visit, last_score as score, to_char(next_visit_due_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as due from v_sites where status = 'trading' and next_visit_due_on <= current_date + 30 order by next_visit_due_on

sections.title: Agreements ending in the next year
sections.note: With the date the end of term notice is due (s36).
sections.sql: select ref, site, franchisee, state, to_char(term_end, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as term_ends, to_char(notice_due_by, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as notice_due_by, coalesce(to_char(end_of_term_notice_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || end_of_term_intent, '') as notice_given from v_agreements where status = 'active' and term_end <= current_date + 365 order by term_end

name: royalties
title: Royalties and the marketing fund
subtitle: The royalty run, arrears and the fund, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Last month's royalty run
sections.note: Every trading site for the last full month.
sections.sql: select site_ref as site, site as name, currency, coalesce(to_char(gross_sales_cents / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990'), 'not reported') as sales, to_char(royalty_cents / 100.0, 'FM999,990') as royalty, to_char(marketing_cents / 100.0, 'FM999,990') as levy, state from v_royalties where period = (date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '1 month')::date order by site_ref

sections.title: Overdue and unreported
sections.note: Months past their due date with money or a sales report still missing.
sections.sql: select site_ref as site, site as name, franchisee, month, currency, to_char(balance_cents / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990') as balance, state from v_royalties where state like 'OVERDUE%' or state = 'NOT REPORTED' order by period

sections.title: Monthly network sales
sections.note: Reported gross sales by month and currency.
sections.sql: select to_char(period, 'Mon YYYY') as month, currency, count(gross_sales_cents) as sites_reported, to_char(sum(gross_sales_cents) / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990') as sales from v_royalties group by period, currency order by period desc, currency

sections.title: The marketing fund by year
sections.note: The statement is due within four months of the year end (s31).
sections.sql: select to_char(fy_end, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as year_to, to_char(levied_cents / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990') as levied, to_char(collected_cents / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990') as collected, to_char(spent_cents / 100.0, 'FM999,999,990') as spent, to_char(statement_due_by, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as statement_due, coalesce(to_char(fund_statement_prepared_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'not yet') as prepared from v_fund order by fy_end desc
